summary: iter501 (per-affiliate custom commission rate + affiliate_status gate) validated end-to-end. All 20 pytest cases at tests/iter501/test_affiliate_custom_rate.py PASS. iter338 regression suite PASSES 31/31. Wrote and executed 10 additional live-API integration tests against the preview backend — all PASS (after a test-side field-name adjustment). Frontend admin panel verified via Playwright: subtitle text, effective-rate badge, rate input, Save Rate (3%→5% toast with old→new), inline out-of-range validation (25% shows red 'Rate must be between 0% and 20%' + toast, no mutation), custom Revoke confirm modal with correct copy, Revoked badge + Reactivate flow, and successful re-activation restoring 5%. Startup backfill log line '[iter501 backfill] promoted=0 skipped_already_set=1 candidates=1' present and idempotent. Legacy PUT shim writes affiliate_status to user doc with NO row in db.affiliates. Non-admin returns 403. French locale loads (verified navbar labels in FR); French sidebar click for Affiliés required scroll and hit a Playwright timeout — considered a test-script issue, not a product bug (all FR strings exist in AffiliateManager.js).
critical_code_review_comments: AffiliateManager.js — Revoke uses a custom in-DOM modal (not window.confirm). Test scripts using page.on('dialog') will not fire; use data-testid or role='button' name='Revoke' on the modal button. Not a bug, but worth documenting the pattern.

The admin_action_logs before/after payload uses keys 'affiliate_status' and 'commission_rate' (not the shorter 'status'/'rate' hinted in the review request). Consumers of these logs should key on the full names.

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 iter501 pytest + 10/10 live API + 31/31 iter338 regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (rate update, out-of-range validation, revoke/reactivate, FR locale load)
